text: Hino jeyaa e maandeeji tindinayɗi e kattal e gootaagu Makko ngun: tagugol kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin, e ɗin ruugayɗi haawniiɗi, ɗi O saakiti hakkunde majji. Kanko e fii mooɓindiroygol ɓe ngol ñaawa ɓe yoɓita ɓe, nde O haaji e mun woo, ko O hattanɗo. O ronkataa fii mun, wano woniri O ronkaano tagugol ɓe ka arannde laawol.
